description: A template token no value fills is exit 3 naming it; a token value with a newline or brace is refused; a sweep file without the marker line is exit 3. On the CLI, a skill directory whose sweep-decide-apply.md has no Dream Drafter Brief marker is a clean exit 3 naming it; with the live template, --items naming anything but drafts.json is a usage error; and a phase brief without --snapshot-sha is a usage error that writes no brief.
